class.name: IfcHumidifier
class.brief_description: A humidifier is a device that adds moisture into the air. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcHumidifier defines the occurrence of any humidifier; common information about humidifier types is handled by IfcHumidifierType .
